paragraphs: Rav Lili bar Mamal said in the name of Mar Ukva, who spoke in the name of Shmuel, [Yevamot 12a](https://www.sefaria.org/Yevamot.12a.5). Yuchasin reads Lili bar Mani.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The named William Davidson vocalized Yevamot 12a text explicitly gives Rav Lili bar Mamal, Mar Ukva, Shmuel as a reporting chain. יב. follows the period convention for 12a; the line break does not detach Shmuel from the chain.

Hyman reports Lili bar Mani from Yuchasin. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2371&lang=en) files the notice under Mani and gives Mamal as the Gemara reading, with the same transmission.
